notes: ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς: upon is read as realizing the dative government under rule 106's closing clause rather than the preverb, since the preverb reading would leave the bare dative pronoun with no case preposition and rule 21 forbids a bare one on an article.
Genitive absolute Λαλούντων … αὐτῶν split into participle (as … spake) and expressed subject (they) under rules 2 and 86.
